snippet.title: Snoot Game (2021) Final Trailer - Cavemanon Studios
snippet.description:
The game's second trailer made in preparation for the final content update from November 2021 (Patch 7)  that finished a lot of the assets and dialog that didn't make the initial launch + some new extra chapters!

Download the game in full here:
snootgame.xyz

================================================================================
I was the Lead Artist of Snoot Game. Yeah it might seem as if this was posted anonymously, but this is about as official as it gets. No one made the call, so I judged it to be right that the trailer for Snoot Game be posted semi-anonymously when Cavemanon had no stabilished social media presence, even after the initial trailer dropped (which I also posted).

I personally had no involvement in the Trailers, it was originally edited/made by someone working on the /v/3 event, using pre-release footage from a hopelessly unfinished version of the game while we were still crunching on all the assets we could deliver prior to "launch" (which I personally never agreed on, as there is no special significance to having it drop on /v/3. Nowadays it doesn't matter because the "lead" dev had a falling out with those guys anyway.)

Release brought about a bunch of talent into the operation, all skilled cool folks that would not only help us finish Snoot Game for Thanksgiving 2021, but also go on to help with the initial development of Exit 665 in 2022, Wani in 2023, and Exit again in 2024 (though in a reduced capacity with newer folks coming in).

The Anon who edited/animated this trailer was a particularly talented fellow that became extremely helpful with the rendering and encoding of Wani's cutscenes, on top of animating some stuff himself. His most recent work you can see in the cutscene for the Exit 665 Teaser released March 2025.
=============================================================================
